title: eBay listings
description: Two row types share one dataset: item (one eBay listing from a search page or an item page, charged) and status (one per keyword or URL, free).

item_id.description: eBay's numeric listing id — the number in any /itm/ URL.

title.description: Listing title as the seller wrote it.

query.description: Search rows: the keyword that returned this listing.

search_url.description: Search rows: the exact eBay URL this page was read from, filters included.

page.description: Which results page the row came from.

position.description: The slot in eBay's own result order, counted across pages.

domain.description: Marketplace domain suffix, e.g. com or co.uk.

price.description: Price as a number. For a price range, the low bound — what a shopper compares on. Null when eBay withholds the price (a MAP-restricted listing shows "See price" until checkout); price_display then carries eBay's own wording, and a run with price bounds set drops those rows free rather than billing them.

price_display.description: Price exactly as eBay printed it, range and currency prefix included.

currency.description: Currency read from the rendered price, not assumed from the marketplace.

list_price.description: Struck-through original price when eBay shows one.

discount_pct.description: How far below the list price the current price sits, in percent.

shipping_cost.description: Shipping charge as a number; 0 when delivery is free.

shipping_display.description: Shipping line exactly as printed, delivery estimate included.

free_shipping.description: True when eBay shows free delivery.

condition.description: Condition label: Brand New, Pre-Owned, Open Box, Certified - Refurbished and so on.

bids.description: Auction rows: how many bids have been placed.

time_left.description: Auction rows: eBay's own time-left text, e.g. "9m" or "1d 4h".

best_offer.description: True when the seller accepts offers.

units_sold.description: How many units this listing has sold — the closest public signal to real demand.

watchers.description: How many shoppers are watching this listing.

returns.description: Returns line when eBay shows one, e.g. "Free returns" or "30 days returns".

seller_feedback_count.description: Seller's feedback score, expanded from eBay's abbreviated form (40.6K -> 40600).

rating.description: Product star rating out of 5, when the listing is matched to an eBay catalogue product.

ratings_count.description: How many product ratings that catalogue product has.

results_total.description: How many listings eBay reports for the whole search.

quantity_available.description: Item-page rows: availability text, e.g. "Last one" or "More than 10 available".

breadcrumbs.description: Item-page rows: eBay's category path for this listing.

category.description: Item-page rows: the leaf category from the breadcrumb.

item_specifics.description: Item-page rows: the seller's specifics table — brand, model, MPN, colour, size and the rest.

seller_url.description: Item-page rows: the seller's eBay store or profile URL.

status.description: Status rows: ok, no_results or error.

target.description: Status rows: the keyword or URL this job was given.

kind.description: Status rows: search, url or item.

items.description: Status rows: listing rows delivered by this job.

filtered.description: Status rows: rows dropped by your price bounds, never charged.

duplicates.description: Status rows: listings another job in the run already delivered.

pages.description: Status rows: how many pages were requested.

error.description: Status rows: why the job failed, null when it did not. An eBay refusal lands here, never as an empty result.

fetched_at.description: UTC timestamp when the row was fetched.
